subject: Weekend push: conversion credit request for Pulse Labs pilot
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Weekend push: conversion credit request for Pulse Labs pilot

Hey team,

Quick one: Pulse Labs (deal PL-9812) is on the last day of their trial and the buying committee told Aaron they need a small token uplift to feel comfortable signing a 6-month paid commitment. The ask from the customer is a one-time platform credit to cover additional tokens for the remainder of the trial and a small runway after sign.

Why: they hit a blocker on query volume during the pilot and want to validate a real load spike before committing. They’ve been very positive on latency/quality — this looks like a fast conversion if we move.

What I’m proposing: 150k token credit applied as an account-level coupon that can be redeemed over 30 days post-signature. Net cost (approx): $4,500. We’d require a firm signature within 72 hours and we’ll attach a short amendment to the SOW (saying credit is non-refundable, one-time).

Attachments: spreadsheet with token math + MAP snapshot (pulse-credit-breakdown.xlsx, pulse-MAP-snapshot.pdf). See details in the sheet, but highlights: expected monthly consumption after ramp = ~60k tokens; this credit buys them full confidence to sign for an initial 6-month seat.

Request: approval to provision the 150k token credit and sign the amendment. Need go/no-go by 9 AM PT Saturday so Aaron can loop legal and send the DocuSign.

Thanks — Steph
--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend push: conversion credit request for Pulse Labs pilot

Steph —

Thanks for the clear write-up. I’m supportive of a limited one-time credit here to unblock the close. Two small asks before I greenlight:

- Cap the credit at 150k tokens and ensure it expires 30 days after signature (you already called this out).
- Laura: can you confirm a one-line amendment/stamp that the credit is applied to invoices post-sign and is non-refundable? I want legal/finance on record.

Assuming Laura is good, you have my verbal approval. Please confirm the DocuSign contents include the credit amount and redemption window.

—Ben
Director, Sales Operations
ben@redwoodinference.com

Cc: Maya Singh <maya@pulselabs.ai>
Date: 2027-07-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend push: conversion credit request for Pulse Labs pilot

Stephanie, Ben —

Thanks for moving fast on this. Pulse is aligned on the ask; 150k tokens and a 30-day redemption window is exactly what we need. If Redwood can add that to the DocuSign by Saturday morning, I can get our legal sign-off and we’ll counter-sign within the 72-hour window.

One request on our side: can we have the credit applied as an account-level promo (so it shows on the first invoice after activation) and a short clause that unused credit will not be refunded but may be reallocated at your discretion? That keeps accounting tidy for us.

If you can send the DocuSign link I’ll make sure it gets prioritised. Appreciate the flexibility — the team is excited to move to prod with Redwood.

Best,
Aaron
Head of ML Ops, Pulse Labs
aaron@pulselabs.ai

Date: 2027-07-03T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend push: conversion credit request for Pulse Labs pilot

Folks — quick update and execution notes.

1) Laura: Ben gave verbal approval pending your confirmation. Can you approve the amendment text below? I’ve pasted a 2-line clause we plan to add to the SOW: 

"Redwood Inference will issue a one-time, non-refundable account credit in the amount equivalent to 150,000 tokens. The credit will be redeemable for 30 days following the execution date of the Amendment and will be applied to invoices as a line-item discount. Unused credit will not be refunded and may be reallocated at Redwood's discretion."

2) Aaron: I uploaded the DocuSign envelope and included the amendment clause as a short exhibit. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/ABC123-pulse-ds

3) Finance ops: after signature, please provision the coupon code PL-9812-150K and mark it as account-level; I’ll copy billing in the closure email.

Laura, if you can reply with an explicit OK (even a one-line), I’ll hit send to Aaron and get the signature started.

Thanks — we should have this across the finish line by EOD Sunday if everything goes to plan.

Steph
--
